page.layout: One title page: the title block centred at the top, an engraved woodcut ornament with figure in the middle, the printer's imprint below it, and the date at the foot, below a rule.

l.i: Nec non ejusdem authoris analysis epistolæ

main_text.l: Additæ sunt necessariæ quædam notæ per JOHAN.

page.notes: Engraving: an oval woodcut ornament with scrollwork and flowers at the corners, showing a seated figure with a bird above and a landscape with trees. Around the oval is a band with the letters "ANNO" and roman numerals, partly illegible. The date line "cIↄ Iↄ cI." is rendered as MDCI. The "Ad Theffalonicenfes" line is copied with long s as printed; it reads "Thessalonicenses" in the usual spelling. The imprint "HERBORNÆ NASSOVIORVM," is set in a decorative, swash-like letterform, read here as Latin, not Greek. The "Nec" of the subtitle has a large decorative initial. The "PAU-" / "LI" break is a printed hyphen at the line end.
